why: A bold Question at the head of a procedural line is no label: the line is a PROCEDURAL row with no speaker.
title: Sample Question
html:
Mr A: Intro.

Question , "That clause 15 stand part of the Bill", put, and negatived.

Clause 15 accordingly disagreed to.
